course.title: Power System Protection
course.department: Department of Electrical and Electronic Engineering

content.value: A line section has an impedance of (2.8+j5) Ω. Show this on R-X diagram as (12) impedance vector. If the relay is adjusted to operate for a zero impedance short circuit at the end of the line section. Show on the same R-X diagram the characteristics of reactance and Mho relay. Assume that centre of Mho relay lies on an impedance vector. If the arcing fault occurs with an impedance of (1.5+j0) Ω anywhere along the line, find for each type of distance relay the maximum portion of the line that can be protected.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2016
